sn48.51:1.5: The “qualities that lead to awakening” (_bodhipakkhiyā dhammā_) are none other than the five faculties themselves. This term is used repeatedly in this Saṁyutta in this sense. Outside of this context, it is used occasionally in the general sense of meditative development, without further specification ([an5.56:3.1]()). In three instances it is extended to “seven” such qualities ([dn27:30.5](), [iti82:3.1](), [iti97:4.2]()), which the commentary identifies with the seven sets of dhammas totalling 37 (rather than the seven awakening factors alone).
